data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Rosaline and the Latin name Roxana. Rosaline means 'rosy one' or 'rose', while Roxana means 'bright, shining one'. The combination of these two names creates the meaning 'Rose Star'. The name Roxine carries the meaning “Rose, star” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Roxine usually hope their child will grow to embody rose, star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
